rows.grounds: verb expressing release from sin as result of the prior rite
compound indicating totality of sins from which one is freed
compound naming the posthumous realm of dwelling
optative verb expressing the resulting state after death
past participle qualifying the subject at the time of attaining that realm

items.question: What liberation and posthumous destination result from bathing at that sacred site?
premises: Bathing at the described sacred site yields great fruit.
One who performs this act is freed from all sins.
After death, such a person dwells in the world of Brahma.
items.inference: Therefore, the ritual bathing grants freedom from all sins and leads to dwelling in Brahma's world after death.
items.plain_english: One is freed from all sins and, after death, dwells in the world of Brahma.
